title: Around the Corner
brief:
The chest is in a separate room. You'll need to combine multiple directions in sequence — the hero performs the lines in the order you wrote them.

Tip: trace the path with your finger first. Count how many tiles in each direction before writing anything.
solution:
move_right()
move_right()
move_right()
move_right()
move_right()
move_down()
move_down()
move_down()
move_left()
move_left()
move_left()
open_chest()
